ds.desktop.notify

Class NotificationBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • ds.desktop.notify.NotificationBuilder

  • public class NotificationBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
    Utilitary object that allows easy and flexible build of notifications that fit any of your evil interests. For those who want to keep more control on what their notifications show or didn't find any static method that did the trick.

    HOW-TO:
    1. Instance an object of this class.
      NotificationBuilder builder = new NotificationBuilder();
    2. Append all the stuff you want into the builder. For instace:
      builder.setTitle("My title").setMessage("Random message").setIcon(myIcon);
      Just look at how easy is to chain calls with this thing.
    3. Build your notification by calling build().
      DesktopNotify notification = builder.build();
    4. When you're ready to show the notification, call DesktopNotify.show().
      notification.show();
      You may prefer to chain the calls if you want to show it right now.
      builder.build().show();
      Before you ask, yeah, you can spawn as many notifications as you please at this point, and they'll all look the same.
    5. Once you're done, call reset() to begin from scratch if you need to.
      builder.reset();
      There's the method buildAndReset(), if you want to fetch your new notification and erase all the contents set in the builder.
      DesktopNotify notification = builder.buildAndReset();
      It works just like build(), you can even chain calls with this.
      builder.buildAndReset().show();
    This class is reusable and not thread-safe.
    Since:
    05/21/2016 (0.8)

      • build

        public DesktopNotify build()
        Builds a new DesktopNotify object. Once you've got to this point, apend a call to DesktopNotify.show() to make it appear inmmediately or just hold onto it until you need to show it. You may continue from the current state in order to customize and build a new notification.
        Returns:
        A brand new and fully customized DesktopNotify object for it to be used in any of your evil interests.
